machine.name: Servo Piston Filler / Depositor
machine.manufacturer: Volumetric Technologies (an Excelis Packaging Automation company)
machine.category: Liquid Filling Machines > Piston Fillers > Servo Series

oem_published.control: servo drive + touchscreen HMI, PLC in UL-listed panel
oem_published.cycle_profile: soft start, fast fill, soft end

V_disp_pf.note: 32 US fl oz nominal deposit, inside the published 0.05-156.64 oz range

dS_pos_pf.note: servo positional repeatability: C5 screw lead grade + preload backlash + following error

dD_bore_pf.note: bore machining tolerance, half of a 0.001 in band

e_spec_pf.note: the published accuracy the machine must hold -- drives the whole geometry

gdot_max_pf.note: wall shear ceiling before shear-sensitive product degrades

eta_vol_pf.note: volumetric efficiency: valve leak-back + product compressibility

P_atm_pf.note: atmospheric pressure -- the ceiling on suction driving force

mu_seal_pf.note: PTFE-on-steel friction coefficient (OEM lists PTFE seals)

e_loadcell_pf.note: load-cell feedback error (OEM lists load cell feedback)

n_cycles_pf.note: cycle rate for a 32 oz deposit (OEM ceiling is 90/min at small fills)

f_disch_pf.note: fraction of cycle spent on the discharge stroke

n_heads_pf.note: 4 heads, inside the published 1-24 head range

H_belt_pf.note: conveyor surface height -- ergonomic standard, not a fill parameter

D_bore_pf.label: DERIVED optimal bore (min RSS geometric error)

S_stroke_pf.label: DERIVED stroke for the nominal deposit

S_min_pf.label: Minimum stroke still holding the spec

V_min_pf.label: Smallest deposit this cylinder can hold to spec

Q_pf.label: Mean flow rate over discharge stroke

v_nz_pf.label: Nozzle exit velocity at mean flow

tau_w_pf.label: Wall shear stress at the nozzle

mu_app_pf.label: Apparent viscosity at operating shear rate

dP_nz_pf.label: Nozzle pressure drop at mean flow

T_screw_pf.label: Motor torque to hold thrust through the screw

T_acc_pf.label: Motor torque to accelerate rotating inertia

P_servo_pf.label: Peak servo shaft power, one head

trace.equation: e_tot_pf = sqrt(e_bore_pf**2 + e_loadcell_pf**2 + e_stroke_pf**2 + e_thermal_pf**2 + e_valve_pf**2)
e_tot_pf = sqrt(e_bore_pf**2 + e_loadcell_pf**2 + e_stroke_pf**2 + e_thermal_pf**2 + e_valve_pf**2)

gdot_in_pf.label: Inlet-port wall shear rate on suction

P_head_pf.label: Hopper static head at the cylinder inlet

formulas_added.name: pf_seal_friction_force
formulas_added.equation: F_seal_pf = mu_seal_pf * P_seal_pf * pi * D_bore_pf * w_seal_pf

formulas_added.name: pf_rss_fill_accuracy
formulas_added.equation: e_tot_pf = sqrt(e_stroke_pf**2 + e_bore_pf**2 + e_valve_pf**2 + e_thermal_pf**2 + e_loadcell_pf**2)
